LanguageData.RT_T28_Vehicle_Blueprint.label: T-28
LanguageData.RT_T28_Vehicle_Blueprint.description:
An early multi-turreted medium tank, equipped with a 76mm gun and lots of machineguns, has poor armor but can upgrade with welded extra armor.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x3，MG gunner x2
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
76.2x385mmR（Main Cannon）
7.62x54mmR（MG）
